top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a simple structure-property rule, a lipid whose apparent pKa keeps the particle near-neutral in blood and charged in the acidifying endosome, assembled into particles that carry a polyanion across a membrane. It opened a new modality, is validated at scale (patisiran, COVID-19 vaccines) and is complementary to the 2023 Medicine prize, which honoured the cargo and not the vehicle. The Cullis, MacLachlan, Anderson allocation rests on my reading of the record and Hope and Madden remain a real alternative, but the objections concern attribution and not the science. P001 is a mature, cleanly attributed pair and a sound second choice, though closer to the 2010 cross-coupling prize; any award is preferable to none.
